given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator initiates an amendment to an active Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The system processes the amendment request
given_when_then.then: A new version of the agreement is created with updated terms, and the previous version is archived as historical data.

given_when_then.given: The Platform Operator creates a new Store Partner Agreement
given_when_then.when: The system processes the creation request
given_when_then.then: A new active version of the agreement is created with the specified commercial terms.

success_criteria: New agreement versions are created with incremented version numbers when amendments are processed.
Previous agreement versions are automatically marked as historical when a new version is created.
Order Requests can only be allocated to Store Partners with active agreement versions.
Only the Platform Operator and the Store Partner associated with the agreement can access agreement edit functions.
